legalAuthority.label: V.I. Code tit. 20, § 404 — Tariff of automobiles for hire
legalAuthority.finding: The Taxicab Commission fixes maximum rates and a complete tariff must be posted in every vehicle for hire.

legalAuthority.label: V.I. Code tit. 20, § 405 — statutory schedules
legalAuthority.finding: Contains historical island schedules and the nearest-tariffed-place rule; later Commission schedules supersede rates changed by the Commission.

governmentEvidence.label: Virgin Islands Taxicab Commission
governmentEvidence.finding: Current government contact page; it does not expose downloadable rate schedules.

governmentEvidence.label: Legislature budget record
governmentEvidence.finding: Records the Commission board's June 2022 vote for an overall 50 percent tariff increase.

activationPolicy: A candidate transcription remains draft until the corresponding Commission-issued schedule is obtained, hashed, attached as a commission_schedule source, and approved by an identified reviewer.
